name: 3 Lucky Monkeys Hold & Win

features.name: Monkey pots
features.description: Special coins charge the Expand, Collect and Boost pots during the base game.

features.name: Upgraded Hold & Win
features.description: The pots power up the respin bonus when it triggers.

features.name: Five jackpots
features.description: From Mini to the Royal prize, with 5,000x for a full expanded grid.

review:
Old-school 5x3, 20 lines, gold coins – but the three monkey pots above the reels are what make it. Coins that land in the base game fly into the Expand, Collect or Boost pot, and each pot shows exactly what it'll add when the bonus opens. You always know what you're building towards.

When Hold & Win finally lands, the pots kick in: Expand makes the grid bigger, Collect scoops up coin values and Boost pumps them up. Five jackpots sit inside, up to a Royal prize, and a full expanded grid pays the 5,000x top win. Medium volatility, 96.98% RTP – a steady one with a real sense of progress.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
